objective: Association of daily regional ambient NO2 short-term exposure and fixed 2013-01-01 to 2020-05-19 regional long-term NO2 exposure with daily COVID-19 incidence and mortality in Lombardia and Veneto during the first epidemic wave.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Association of daily regional ambient NO2 short-term exposure and fixed 2013-01-01 to 2020-05-19 regional long-term NO2 exposure with daily COVID-19 incidence and mortality in Lombardia and Veneto during the first epidemic wave.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths among residents of Lombardia and Veneto, Italy.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Rate ratio per 1 µg/m³ increase in NO2 STAP and per 1 µg/m³ increase in NO2 LTAP, separately for daily cases and daily deaths.
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: Lombardia and Veneto administrative regions, Italy

article_evidence.finding: Complete article and supplement establish daily cases/deaths, regions, date period, STAP/LTAP construction, lockdown primary model, and sensitivity variants.

article_evidence_map.target_discrepancy: Supplied target includes epidemic time, while the article primary equation specifies lockdown only; meteorology is supplement sensitivity.
